### Global Metadata
A complete 90-second quiet summer-night piece for walking through a small sleeping Japanese town under street lamps, peaceful and a little lonely. 64 BPM, A-flat major. Soft felt piano, vibraphone, a warm fretless bass, brushed cymbal swells, a distant soft string pad. Pure instrumental ensemble piece.

### Vocal Details
None. Instrumental only: piano and vibraphone play a slow melody together.

### Timed Arrangement
0-18 seconds: sparse piano chords and vibraphone. 18-50 seconds: a slow piano melody, fretless bass enters. 50-74 seconds: vibraphone takes the melody over string pad. 74-90 seconds: piano alone, quiet. Keep tempo, texture and loudness consistent from start to end; no big climax. The piece must play for the full 90 seconds and must not end early, ending cleanly on the tonic so it can loop.
